stories.title: Have you seen Kelly? Police searching for 36-year-old missing from Holywell
stories.summary: North Wales Police have appealed for help to find a woman missing from Holywell. The force said officers have concerns for Kelly, 36, and that she may have travelled to Towyn and the surrounding area. Anyone who sees her, or who knows where she is, has been asked to contact North Wales Police on 101

stories.title: Mold: First look at new joint archive for Flintshire and Denbighshire
stories.summary: Plans have revealed how Flintshire’s proposed new £13 million record office and archive will look if approved. stories.title: North Wales woman urges Senedd to act on brain cancer research after husband’s diagnosis
stories.summary: A North Wales woman is urging the Senedd to take action on brain cancer research after her husband was diagnosed with an incurable brain tumour at the age of 34. Joshua Smith, a machinist at Tritech from Wrexham, was diagnosed with a glioblastoma in January after a scan found a 4.5cm mass on his brain.

stories.summary: Parking charges will be introduced at Wepre Park in Connah’s Quay from Monday 27 July. stories.title: Weekend weather: warm Saturday then Sunday rain for Flintshire
stories.summary: Flintshire is set for a warm, dry Saturday before rain arrives on Sunday, bringing a brief change after weeks of dry weather. The Met Office forecast for Flintshire shows a high of 24C on Saturday, with the morning dry and the chance of rain rising to 30% from mid-afternoon. Temperatures are expected to reach 23C
